title: A city of projects
say: Every building is a project started with Claude Code. Height is how much work went in. Colour is its state: clay waits on me, red is blocked on someone else, violet has a written checkpoint.
do: Point at the legend on the right, then the front row: touched this month.

title: It started with one file
say: At the end of every session, Claude writes .claude/session-state.md: the stage, the next step, the proof it worked, the blockers. Weeks later I'd open it and wonder: is this still true? That question is why this app exists.
do: Point at NEXT ACTION and PROOF: both come straight from calculator's session-state.md.

title: What good looks like
say: Gate PASS. The proof is not a claim: it's the real test run plus a commit git can find.

title: Break it live
say: I'll change the code and leave the note alone. Watch this building.
do: Second terminal, in the repo folder: py demo/make_demo.py --commit calculator . Wait 10 seconds, press F5.

title: It noticed
say: STALE: dashed roof, gate FAIL. The note was written before the latest work, so the app stops trusting it.
do: Then: py demo/make_demo.py --checkpoint calculator , press F5. It passes again, and the proof cites the new commit.

title: Stale on its own
say: Nobody touched this on stage. A commit landed hours after its note, so its next step may already be done.
do: Point at the STALE pill and 'written before the latest work'.

title: A commit that never existed
say: It says shipped, tests pass, commit 4f9e2a1. The app asked git: that commit was never made. No model needed to catch it.

title: A quote that doesn't match
say: Its reason quotes NOTES.md: 'two hours a day'. The file actually says a week. Quotes are checked word for word.
do: Point at WHY and the gate question.

title: 'Continue' is not a next step
say: The gate doesn't just fail. It asks the one question to answer next. Here: the next step is filler, and a blocker has no owner.

title: Waiting on me
say: A blocker with my name on it becomes 'waiting on you' in the header. That's the list I check every morning.
do: Point at the clay '2 waiting on you' pill at the top.

title: The story, told by Claude
say: How it started, where it is now, and every session as a chapter that Claude titled itself. Nothing here was typed by hand.
do: Scroll to HOW IT STARTED and the chapter list.

title: Checked, or only written down
say: Every project, failing first. Under each one: what the machine checked, yes or no, and what is only someone's word.
do: Point at '22/26 checks hold', then scroll to pomodoro-timer and invoice-parser: each has one 'no'.

title: Take it home
say: End every session with a next step, proof it worked, and who owns each blocker. Then check the note against the work before you trust it.
do: Press T to hide this guide for questions.
